Trace, implement and test: leetcode12 integer to roman

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    string intToRoman(int num) {
        string res;
        vector<int> vals = {1000,900,500,400,100,90,50,40,10,9,5,4,1};
        /* 注意: 只有I,X,C可以在临近大小值的左侧位置, 剩下的 V,L,D,M不能 */
        vector<string> strs = {"M", "CM","D", "CD", "C", "XC", "L", "XL", "X", "IX", "V", "IV","I"};
        for(int i=0; i < vals.size(); i++)
        {
            while(num >= vals[i])  /* 循环出口：只要够减，就继续 */
            {
                num -= vals[i];
                res.append(strs[i]);
            }
        }
        return res;
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    int n = 4999;
    string res = sol.intToRoman(n);
    cout << res << endl;

    return 0;
}
